subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 210 (T(IMP)M-8). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DT (expansion dictates), INFO-FR (information forum) and FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics). From EXP-DT: SG (source initiation). From SG: DEF (definition), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From INFO-FR: MD-DY (media dynamics). From MD-DY: ROTP (responsibility of the position). From ROTP: JR-DY (journalism dynamics). From FUND-DY: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental). From PER-PHY-U-FUND: UTZ (utilization).
